verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
This is
The day You made
So I’ll rejoice and be glad
Rejoice and be glad in it

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
This is
Where I believe
You are more than enough
More than enough for me

verse.name: p1
verse.lines:
You are faithful to Your promise
You are strong when I am weak
When I’m standing in Your presence
I have everything I need

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
The joy of the Lord
The joy of the Lord is my strength
The joy of the Lord
The joy of the Lord is my strength

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
O my soul, bless His Name
All that is within me say
The joy of the Lord
The joy of the Lord is my strength

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Jesus
Come what may
You are worthy of all
Worthy of all my praise

verse.name: b1a
verse.lines:
Let it rise up
Like a river
Overflowing
Holy Spirit

verse.name: b1b
verse.lines:
Let it pour out
With no limit
Overflowing
Holy Spirit

verse.name: o1
verse.lines:
I got the joy
I got the joy
I got the joy
It's the joy of the Lord
It's the joy of the Lord
